newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH C.BANK RAISES 91-DAY, 182-DAY BILL YIELDS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH C.BANK RAISES 91-DAY, 182-DAY BILL YIELDS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland accepted higher average yields on its 91-day and 182-day NBP-bills at Friday's combined 400 million zloty auction even though total demand for the paper was 581 million zlotys.
The bank raised the average yield of the shorter bills to 21.96 from 21.91 percent at the last auction and the yield of the longer paper to 21.99 percent from 21.97 percent.

It sold 100 million zlotys of the 91-day paper, the amount on offer, after banks bid for 251 million zlotys of the bills and 300 million of the 182-day bills against demand of 330 million. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
